description: Defines the SpdySessionPool class and related nested classes and structures for managing SPDY sessions, including session requests, creation, lookup, and lifecycle management within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: SpdySessionPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of open SPDY sessions, handles session creation, lookup, and lifecycle events, and observes network and SSL configuration changes.

classes.name: SpdySessionRequest
classes.description: Represents a request for a SPDY session with a specific key, with a delegate to notify when the session becomes available.

classes.name: SpdySessionRequest::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to be notified when a SPDY session becomes available.

classes.name: GreasedHttp2Frame
classes.description: Holds parameters for sending 'grease' frames in HTTP/2 to prevent fingerprinting.

methods.name: CreateAvailableSessionFromSocketHandle
methods.description: Creates a new SPDY session from an existing socket handle.

methods.name: CreateAvailableSessionFromSocket
methods.description: Creates a new SPDY session from a socket stream with connect timing info.

methods.name: FindAvailableSession
methods.description: Finds an available SPDY session matching the given key.

methods.name: HasAvailableSession
methods.description: Checks if an available session exists for the given key.

methods.name: RequestSession
methods.description: Requests a SPDY session, creating a request object that will be notified when the session is available.

methods.name: OnHostResolutionComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of host resolution, potentially setting up session aliases.

methods.name: MakeSessionUnavailable
methods.description: Marks a session as unavailable, typically when it receives a GOAWAY or error.

methods.name: RemoveUnavailableSession
methods.description: Removes an unavailable session from the pool.

methods.name: CloseCurrentSessions
methods.description: Closes all current sessions with a specified error.

methods.name: CloseAllSessions
methods.description: Closes all sessions, including new ones created during the process.

methods.name: MakeCurrentSessionsGoingAway
methods.description: Marks current sessions as going away due to network change.

methods.name: SpdySessionPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Creates a value summary of the pool's state.

methods.name: GetDnsAliasesForSessionKey
methods.description: Returns DNS aliases associated with a session key.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles network IP address changes, closing or flushing sessions.

methods.name: OnSSLConfigForServerChanged
methods.description: Marks sessions for a specific server as unavailable when SSL config changes.
